Adjust cookie settings

Functional cookies are always active to ensure the website works properly. Limited analytical cookies are always active. They collect minimal, anonymous data about website usage, unique visitors, and popular clicks or searches to help us improve the site while protecting your privacy. Beyond that, you decide if and which cookies you accept. You can always adjust your cookie settings via the “Adjust cookie settings” button in the cookie statement or by clicking “Cookies” at the bottom of every page.

Manage Consent Preferences

A well-functioning and secure website

Always Active

Among other things, this lets us make sure that you:

  • Can use the travel planner and get good travel advice.
  • Can get a clear picture of current malfunctions and maintenance activities.
  • Have the option to log in to your secure customer environment and access your personal data and travel information.
  • Have the option to purchase tickets and/or offers.

Analyze and test our website to improve quality and effectiveness

Always Active

Limited analytical cookies are always active. We use these cookies to measure how our website is used, how many unique users visit our website, and where most clicks or searches occur so that we can improve our website even better. We call these cookies ‘limited analytical’ because they collect minimal information that is not directly traceable to you and therefore have little or no impact on your privacy. We use them, among other things, to:

  • Collect aggregated information over a limited period that is not directly traceable to you, to gain insight into how you use our website. For example, which content works well and which does not based on metrics such as time spent, scroll behaviour, or whether the content enables you to make choices or find relevant information;
  • Collect information to ensure that we can test new functionalities or designs and determine which generate the best user experience. We do this with as little impact on your privacy as possible;
  • Collect statistics to ensure that all parts of our websites work well on all devices and browsers;
  • Offer the possibility to provide feedback on our website, products, and content.

Relevant information and personalized recommendations within our online channels

This allows us to offer you relevant information within our emails, websites, and apps.

  • We collect information about how you visit our emails and website, such as click behavior and pages visited, and combine this (where possible) with your personal data in our customer systems. This is possible if you have a Mijn NS account and are logged in.
  • With this information, we can better tailor content and recommendations via our emails, websites, and apps to your customer relationship, preferences, profile, and expectations.
  • If you have also given this consent on other online channels of NS and NS International, we may combine data from NS.nl with data from those other channels to show you more relevant content and recommendations.

Displaying relevant advertisements outside our online channels, such as on Meta or Google

This allows us to show you relevant advertisements on websites and apps outside NS’s online channels.

  • We collect information about how you visit our emails and website, such as click behavior and pages visited. We combine this (where possible) with your personal data in our customer systems. This is possible if you have a Mijn NS account and are logged in. These data are used within NS customer systems to determine which information is relevant to you.
  • We share which advertisements may be relevant to you with 12 partners using cookies from those partners. They can show you more relevant advertisements on their platforms, apps, and websites. Think of social media platforms such as Meta (Facebook, Instagram), Snapchat, TikTok, Google, and other (social) media. We also advertise on other websites, such as Buienradar.nl and NU.nl.
  • We share information with these partners about how you visit our website to measure the effectiveness of advertisements on (social) media platforms and websites and apps outside NS.
  • These partners may also use the data NS has shared for their own purposes and may combine it with other data they hold about you. They have their own privacy and cookie policies. See our cookie statement for the list of these companies and how they use your data.
  • If you have also given this consent on other online channels of NS and NS International, we may combine data from NS.nl with data from those other channels to show you more relevant advertisements outside our online channels.

Your cookie preferences

The online channels (website, app, and email) of NS Group N.V. use cookies and similar technologies to optimize your user and customer experience. Without functional cookies, our website will not work properly. With limited analytical cookies, we collect and analyze information about how you use our website. These types of cookies are enabled by default. You can enable or disable the other personalization and advertising cookies yourself.

We ask for your consent to use personalization and advertising cookies. By clicking ‘Accept’ you agree to the use of personalization and advertising cookies within and outside NS’s online channels. By clicking ‘Reject’, personalization and advertising cookies remain disabled, and only functional and limited analytical cookies remain active. If you want to manage your cookie settings yourself, choose ‘Adjust cookie settings’. You can change your choice or withdraw your consent at any time via the “Adjust cookie settings” button at the top of our cookie statement or by clicking “Cookies” at the bottom of every page.

With personalization and advertising cookies enabled, we ensure that:

You receive relevant information and personalized recommendations within our online channels.

We collect information about how you visit our emails, app, and website, such as click behavior and pages visited, and combine this (where possible) with your customer data in our customer systems so that we can show you even more personalized information and recommendations. More information about how we process your personal data is available in our Privacy statement

We show you relevant advertisements outside our online channels on platforms such as Meta or Google.

Additionally, we and our 12 partners use advertising cookies to show you personalized recommendations and advertisements (within and) outside our website. Sometimes we share personal data obtained via cookies with our partners (12). More information about how we process your personal data can be found in our Privacy statement.
